props.survey: Radial palm crowns were marked on the OneMap orthophoto at zoom 20. Spread follows the mapped fronds. Three near crowns were height-matched to the bridge rails and canopy outline in the first field photo. Other heights use crown diameter and the regional canopy-height raster where available. Heights and species are approximate. Four 0 A.D. royal palm variants represent the crowns on land.
